t: The Mekanism Fluid Port allows you to extract vapor from an $(l:bigreactors:reactor/active)actively cooled$(/l) Reactor as a Mekanism Gas.$(br2)This Port automatically converts the vapor into a gas if a Mekanism Rotary recipe exists for the fluid stored inside the Reactor. The conversion rate as defined by the Rotary recipe is respected.
Mekanism 流体端口允许你将$(l:bigreactors:reactor/active)主动冷却$(/l)反应堆中的蒸汽以通用机械气体的形式提取出来。$(br2)如果反应堆中储存的流体存在对应的 Mekanism Rotary 配方，该端口会自动将蒸汽转换为气体。转换速率会遵循 Rotary 配方中定义的数值。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() Reinforced$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
